overview.description: The Innovator International Developed Power Buffer ETF March (IMAR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims to participate in the price movement of iShares MSCI EAFE ETF (ticker: EFA), up to a predetermined cap, while buffering the first 15% of losses over a one-year period starting March 1. The actively managed fund utilizes FLEX options and collateral IMAR was launched on Feb 29, 2024 and is issued by Innovator.

completeness: holdings are every published row for this account in the issuer's all-funds holdings CSV, and all of them share one Date
weights are the provider's signed Weightings values; long and short option legs, money market and Cash & Other stay exactly as published with no sum-to-100 check
shares outstanding and AUM are published only when every selected row agrees on a finite value; otherwise they are omitted rather than guessed
option legs carry a composite provider ticker, so symbol is set only for plain tickers
the CSV carries no dated history, no fund classification and no notional exposure
